Above: The Women's Team and supporters at St. Albans.
Back row: Derek Jones, Win Shepherd, Cynthia James, Jean Hutcherson, Richard James, Raymond James, Natalie Stracey, Sue Porter, Helen Maskrey, Peter Simon, Jenny Christou, Nina Mills, Sasha Kulidzan, Pat Mead, Mr. Powell, Michelle Powell, Hazel Mead, Carly Mullins, Veronica Simon.

Bottom row: Harry Porter, Barbara Kulidzan, Angela Patten, Jackie Stone, Jacqui Smiter, Sophia Howard.

Above: At the home UKWAL match at Sutton the Belles just missed stretching their win streak to cover two complete seasons.  Another four match points would have done it – but they don’t seem too downhearted as they now look forward to 2007 and UKWAL Division Two.

From left to right – standing: Juliet Fielden, Katryna Euridge, Eva Massey, John Vernon, Sarah Gailey, Jayne Anderson, Chris Privett, Claire Robinson, Bob Bridges (Joint Team Manager), Cynthia James (Joint Team Manager), Rex Bale, Carl Lawton, Jennifer Culley, Tony Fairclough, Sarah Murphy, Derek Jones, Ray James. Kneeling: Sarah Wellstead, Janine Whitlock, Gail Porter, Dian Holden, Hazel Mead.
Congratulations to Cynthia James, elected Life Member of Belgrave Harriers at the 1998 A.G.M. and pictured here with husband Ray.
